faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about KAMBRIQ and our services.

q1.question: How do I buy land from abroad?
q1.answer: Buying from abroad is done in 4 simple steps: browse our available lands, select the land and request a virtual tour, our local team verifies and sends you all documents, then secure electronic signature and fund transfer via our banking partner.

q2.question: What documents come with each land?
q2.answer: Each land sold via KAMBRIQ comes with: certified title deed, KAMBRIQ Verify certificate, official cadastral plan, expert surveyor boundary report, non-dispute certificate, and complete transaction history.

q3.question: Are all lands titled?
q3.answer: Yes, absolutely. KAMBRIQ only sells lands with Definitive Title Deeds (TDT). Every title is verified by our experts and at the Cadastre. We guarantee 100% authenticity. Untitled lands are never listed on our platform.

q4.question: What is the KAMBRIQ Verify service?
q4.answer: KAMBRIQ Verify is a professional land verification service that authenticates a property title within 48-72h. Our team verifies at the Cadastre, checks the transaction history, verifies the absence of disputes, and delivers a certificate of compliance with guarantee.

q5.question: How do I become a certified KAMNET Agent?
q5.answer: To become a certified KAMNET Agent, complete the KBS (KAMBRIQ Business School) training: 8 weeks online covering land law, sales techniques and platform usage. You then receive the KCA (KAMBRIQ Certified Associate) certificate and access to the KAMNET network.
